title: [qos_sai] portName referenced before assignment on t1-lag topo
author: vcheketx
body:

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
PR [6393](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/6393) switched to using `portName` instead of `iface` for [t1 topos](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/7afbb6dbd7b0c21d2056c6be7e4279783f487131/tests/qos/qos_sai_base.py#L552).
Since portName is defined inside if loop, it results in `variable referenced before assignment` error if interfaces names do not contain '.'
**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. deploy t1-lag topo
2. run qos/test_qos_sai.py

**Describe the results you received:**
```
                if iface.startswith("Ethernet"):
                    if "." in iface:
                        portName, vlan_id = iface.split(".")
>                   portIndex = mgFacts["minigraph_ptf_indices"][portName]
E                   UnboundLocalError: local variable 'portName' referenced before assignment
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Tests are passed.

**Additional information you deem important:**
<!--
software/ASIC/Hardware Flatform version and info
-->

